facts.text: Owing to its distant astrographic location, focus shifted to richer worlds nearby, leaving a few settlements of few optimistic claim jumpers, fugitives, miners, farmers, and trappers by the end of the Light and Darkness War, who would be the ancestors of Ruusanians.
